name: Being Single
overview: Scripture acknowledges the reality of singleness, as seen in Genesis 2:18 where God declares it is not good for man to be alone, indicating the value of companionship. Yet, Isaiah 41:10 reassures believers that God's presence and strength sustain them in times of solitude. Furthermore, Hosea 2:19 beautifully portrays God's enduring commitment to His people, promising a spiritual betrothal marked by righteousness, judgment, lovingkindness, and mercy, affirming that being single does not mean being forsaken.
